::: {#sol-three-activations}

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
z = torch.linspace(-4, 4, 401)
activations = {
    "logistic": torch.sigmoid(z),
    "tanh": torch.tanh(z),
    "max(0, z)": torch.relu(z),
}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 3.5))
for name, value in activations.items():
    ax.plot(z, value, label=name)
ax.axhline(0, color="gray", linewidth=0.5)
ax.set_xlabel("z")
ax.set_ylabel("g(z)")
ax.legend()
plt.show()
```

- **Large positive $z$.**
  $\sigmoidf{z}$ levels off at 1 and $\tanhf{z}$ levels off at 1,
  while $\maxf{0, z} = z$ keeps growing.
- **Large negative $z$.**
  $\sigmoidf{z}$ levels off at 0, $\tanhf{z}$ levels off at $-1$,
  and $\maxf{0, z}$ is exactly 0 for every negative $z$.

$\tanh$ is a rescaled [logistic function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/functions.html#def-logistic-function), $\tanhf{z} = 2 \sigmoidf{2z} - 1$,
so its graph is the same S curve, centred on 0 instead of $\frac{1}{2}$.

:::
